description: M1 catalog of every pack variant under astrid/packs/. Classifies packs by the capability types they ship (executors, orchestrators, elements). Aligns with INTERNAL_PACK_DIRS constant in astrid/structure.py. Updated post M1 Pack Layout Normalization to reflect final normalized state and documented exceptions.

variant_classifications.manifest_only: Has pack.yaml but no executors/, orchestrators/, or elements/ directories with capability subdirectories.
variant_classifications.mixed_executor_orchestrator: Ships both executor and orchestrator capabilities.
variant_classifications.mixed_executor_element: Ships both executor and element capabilities.
variant_classifications.mixed_full: Ships executor, orchestrator, and element capabilities.
variant_classifications.internal: Infrastructure directory under packs/, not a shipped pack (no pack.yaml).

__pycache__.notes: CPython bytecode cache — removed from pack tree in M1 (T11); gitignore prevents regeneration.

_core.notes: Internal pack infrastructure directory. Contains skill/ with SKILL.md only. No __init__.py (removed in M1 T14), no pack.yaml.

packs.notes: Empty scaffold directories for executors/ and orchestrators/ exist but contain only __init__.py files — no capability subdirectories. Serves as a structural placeholder pack with agent_probe.py (dsl_orchestrator_shim, M2-deferred), fixtures/, and golden/.
Large executor-only pack with 15 executors. Includes skill/ for agent-facing documentation.
Mixed pack with 2 executors and 1 orchestrator (foley_map). Includes skill/.
Executor pack with 3 generation executors (generate_image, generate_video, generate_audio or similar). Includes skill/ and golden/ test fixtures.
Executor pack with 2 executors (assemble, prepare). __init__.py removed in M1 T14 (not needed for sub-package imports).
Single-executor pack (clip_extract). AGENTS.md migrated to skill/SKILL.md in M1 T3; README.md and STAGE.md removed in M1 T17.
Executor pack with 4 executors for Reigh data platform integration. Includes skill/.
Mixed pack with 3 executors and 4 element kinds (animations, effects, transitions, plus _shared contracts). The only pack currently shipping elements. Includes skill/.
Executor pack with 5 executors for RunPod serverless GPU integration (session, exec, etc.).
Mixed pack with 2 executors and 1 orchestrator. Has __init__.py (legacy_public_shim, M2-deferred — preserved for sub-package imports by 6 call sites) and skill/.

Orchestrator pack with 1 DSL orchestrator (summarize, migrated to orchestrators/summarize/run.py in M1 T13). Contains summarize.py (legacy_public_shim, M2-deferred), fixtures/ (including sample.txt), and golden/.
Mixed pack with 4 executors and 2 orchestrators for model training workflows.
Executor pack with 5 executors for media understanding (visual, audio, video analysis). Includes skill/.
Executor pack with 2 executors (run, validate) for VibeComfy integration.
Orchestrator-heavy pack with 1 executor and 7 orchestrators for video editing workflows. Includes skill/ and hype.py (legacy_public_shim, M2-deferred).
Executor pack with 2 executors for YouTube integration.

top_level_pack_files.description: Python modules directly under astrid/packs/ (not in pack subdirectories). In M1 these are all compatibility re-export shims whose canonical implementations live in astrid/core/pack_machinery/.

files.name: cli.py
files.notes: Pack CLI compatibility re-export shim. Canonical implementation moved to astrid/core/pack_machinery/cli.py in M1 T8.

files.name: install.py
files.notes: Pack installation logic. Canonical implementation; machinery re-export shim exists at astrid/core/pack_machinery/install.py. Full relocation deferred to M2.

files.name: validate.py
files.notes: Pack validation compatibility re-export shim. Canonical implementation moved to astrid/core/pack_machinery/validate.py in M1 T6.

files.name: gitignore.py
files.notes: Gitignore filtering compatibility re-export shim. Canonical implementation moved to astrid/core/pack_machinery/gitignore.py in M1 T5.

files.name: agent_index.py
files.notes: Agent index compatibility re-export shim. Canonical implementation moved to astrid/core/pack_machinery/agent_index.py in M1 T7.

files.name: _canonical_entrypoint.py
files.notes: Canonical entrypoint machinery. Not relocated during M1 (50+ import sites). Documented as machinery_shim exception with defer_to: M2.

documented_exceptions.description: Every layout exception that keeps the pack tree from being purely canonical. All are declared in their respective pack.yaml metadata.layout.exceptions and cross-referenced here.

exceptions.reason: DSL @orchestrator definition with 16+ test-file references. Not a canonical executor. Migration to orchestrators/ deferred to M2.
Legacy author-test DSL shim that duplicates video_editing.hype (canonically at orchestrators/hype/run.py). Kept for backward compatibility.
Compatibility re-export preserving astrid.packs.text_analysis.summarize while the canonical implementation lives at orchestrators/summarize/run.py.
Preserved helper-package marker required for sub-package imports (6 call sites).

machinery_shims.reason: 50+ import sites across pack run.py files, in_process.py, and test files.

special_directories.reason: Contains only skill/SKILL.md providing the root Astrid skill description. No pack.yaml, executors, or orchestrators.

structure_constants_reference.note: The shared pack manifest schemas moved out of astrid/packs/ in M1 and now live under astrid/core/pack_machinery/schemas/. The 'schemas' entry in INTERNAL_PACK_DIRS is a legacy reference to per-pack content roots only.
